LanguageData.DateNight_Settings_Intro: Schedule Date or Lovin on the Schedule tab. Date is a walk / table / hangout (mood + opinion, no bed). Lovin still uses a shared double. Adults without a partner in that bed can have private time. Ideology that forbids lovin, and Biotech sterile genes, reroute to a date instead of forcing the job.
LanguageData.DateNight_Settings_PregnancySafeTip: ON (recommended): only shortens lovin chance while scheduled; keeps vanilla post-lovin cooldown. Date uses the same wait (~4–8 hours) after a finished date. OFF with Eager: mirrors Always Do Lovin cooldown (~100 ticks) for lovin and dating.
LanguageData.DateNight_Settings_EagerTip: Shortens post-lovin and post-date cooldown like the Always Do Lovin debug option (~100 ticks). Can spam pregnancy rolls — leave off unless you want that.
LanguageData.DateNight_Settings_SelfLovinTip: Adults on Lovin hours use their own bed when a partner is not sharing a double. No pregnancy. Same cooldown as lovin. Children never qualify.
LanguageData.DateNight_Settings_WindowBedTip: Temporarily assign the rendezvous double to the couple for the Lovin window, then restore their previous beds. Off if you want to assign beds yourself.
LanguageData.DateNight_Settings_ActivitiesTip: Dates pick a real activity based on what's available: dinner at a table, a picnic, a walk, stargazing at night, dancing at a gather spot, a small gift, or recreation near a joy building. Off: dates are always a simple hangout.
LanguageData.DateNight_Settings_QualityTip: Date outcomes vary with the activity, venue beauty, weather, and a little luck — wonderful, nice, or awkward. Off: every finished date gives the flat nice-date thought.
LanguageData.DateNight_Settings_GiftsTip: One partner may fetch a small luxury (beer, chocolate, ambrosia...) and hand it over for a mood and opinion boost. The item moves to the partner's inventory.
LanguageData.DateNight_Settings_PostDateBoostTip: A finished date improves the couple's lovin chance for about one in-game day.
LanguageData.DateNight_Settings_AnniversariesTip: On the anniversary of a love bond: a letter, a special mood if they go on a date that day, and a sting if the day passes without one. Off: no calendar letters or anniversary moods.
LanguageData.DateNight_Settings_FavoriteSpotTip: Couples remember where their best dates happened and prefer to go back. A ruined date can sour that venue. Off: every date picks a fresh spot.
LanguageData.DateNight_Settings_DoubleDatesTip: Two couples with overlapping Date hours may share a table, picnic, or gather spot. Quality rolls once for the group; the evening spills into opinions of the other pair. If the other couple never shows, they date alone.
LanguageData.DateNight_Letter_AnniversaryText: {PAWN} and {PARTNER} have been together for {YEARS}. A date today would mean the world — letting it pass without one will sting.
LanguageData.DateNight_Alert_MismatchDesc: A lover has Date or Lovin painted, but their partner does not — or they painted different hours. Paint the same hours on both.
LanguageData.DateNight_ScheduleComboTip: Date (click). Lovin is in the ▾ menu. This button stays last on the extra schedule row.
